content:
error: LEDGER_SANDBOX_TOKEN is not set. Sandbox tokens expire after 7 days; mint a new one with `acmectl tokens mint ledger-sbx` and export it.
exit=1

The smoke test didn't run. `scripts/ledger_smoke.py` stopped with exit code 1 because `LEDGER_SANDBOX_TOKEN` isn't set in this environment:

```
error: LEDGER_SANDBOX_TOKEN is not set. Sandbox tokens expire after 7 days; mint a new one with `acmectl tokens mint ledger-sbx` and export it.
```

Because it stopped there, nothing was posted to the ledger sandbox.

To get it running, mint a token and run the script again:

```sh
acmectl tokens mint ledger-sbx
export LEDGER_SANDBOX_TOKEN=<token>
python scripts/ledger_smoke.py
```

I didn't mint a token myself because that creates a credential under your account. I can run `acmectl tokens mint ledger-sbx` and retry if you want.

Also, the script currently only checks that the token exists and then prints "posting a test invoice to the ledger sandbox". It doesn't actually send an invoice or print a reference yet, even though its docstring says it does. So once the token is set, a passing run only shows that the token is present, not that the sandbox works.
